assessment: Public source reproduction; no transition hazard or health effect estimated
limitations: Selected repeat health-screening participants in China, 2010-2016; no U.S. transport established.
Published outcomes were known; source agreement is reproduction, not independent clinical validation.
Column T defines one but does not document blanks; preserve unknown versus assumed negative.
Endpoint follow-up varies and ends at diagnosis or last visit; no fixed-horizon annual risk or hazard is estimated.
The release lacks repeated visit histories, treatment timing, competing-death records and post-diabetes remission histories.
No dietary causal effect, diabetes-type validation, sustained remission or engine calibration is established.
population: Selected adults aged at least 20 with repeated health checks and no baseline diabetes

source.citation: Chen Y et al. (2018). Data from: Association of body mass index and age with incident diabetes in Chinese adults: a population-based cohort study. Dryad, DOI 10.5061/dryad.ft8750v; identical Zenodo archive 4997196.
source.correction_note: Published study used-data reproduction; no independent holdout. Metadata identities agree; this does not validate every column semantic.
